en: Gujarat's sixteenth Asiatic lion estimation recorded 891 lions in 2025. Cheetah totals are far more date-sensitive because births, deaths and translocations can change them within days: official reporting gave 57 on 10 May 2026 and about 53 on 13 May after four cub deaths, with 50 at Kuno and three at Gandhi Sagar. Lion and cheetah figures must therefore be attached to their census or reporting date.
te: Gujaratలో 2025లో జరిగిన 16th Asiatic lion estimation 891 lionsను record చేసింది. Cheetah total births, deaths, translocations వల్ల కొద్ది రోజుల్లోనే మారవచ్చు. Official reporting ప్రకారం 10 May 2026న 57 ఉండగా, four cub deaths తరువాత 13 Mayన సుమారు 53—Kunoలో 50, Gandhi Sagarలో 3—మిగిలాయి. కాబట్టి lion, cheetah figuresను census లేదా reporting date లేకుండా quote చేయకూడదు.

en: India's first comprehensive river-dolphin census, released in 2025, estimated about 6,327 dolphins. A second range-wide assessment began under Project Dolphin Phase II in January 2026. The Snow Leopard Population Assessment in India used 2019–2023 fieldwork and reported an estimate of 718 in 2024, establishing a first national baseline. Neither figure should be detached from its survey period and method.
te: India's first comprehensive river-dolphin censusను 2025లో release చేసి సుమారు 6,327 dolphinsను estimate చేశారు. Comparable follow-up కోసం Project Dolphin Phase II కింద January 2026లో second range-wide assessment ప్రారంభమైంది. Snow Leopard Population Assessment in India, 2019–2023 fieldwork ఆధారంగా 2024లో 718 అనే estimate ఇచ్చి first national baselineను ఏర్పరచింది. ఈ రెండు figuresనూ survey period, method నుంచి విడదీసి చదవకూడదు.

en: At the stated reference dates, India had 18 nationally designated Biosphere Reserves, 13 of them in UNESCO's World Network, and 101 Ramsar Sites in August 2026. These are different recognition systems: domestic Biosphere Reserve designation does not automatically confer UNESCO status, while Ramsar designation identifies wetlands of international importance. Both totals are date-sensitive.
te: Stated reference dates ప్రకారం Indiaలో nationally designated Biosphere Reserves 18; వాటిలో UNESCO World Networkలో 13 ఉన్నాయి. August 2026 నాటికి Ramsar Sites 101. ఇవి separate recognition systems. Domestic Biosphere Reserve designationతో automaticగా UNESCO status రాదు; Ramsar designation wetlands of international importanceకు వర్తిస్తుంది. New formal recognitionsతో రెండు totals మారవచ్చు కాబట్టి date తప్పనిసరి.

en: Three national plans are distinguished by their stated periods. The National Vulture Action Plan covered 2020–2025. The National Human–Wildlife Conflict Mitigation Strategy and Action Plan covered 2021–2026. MoEFCC released the National Marine Turtle Action Plan 2021–2026 on 28 January 2021 together with the Marine Mega Fauna Stranding Guidelines. After a stated cycle ends, the document remains an important policy record, but it should not be called the current plan unless an official extension or successor is confirmed.
te: మూడు national plansను వాటి stated periodsతో వేరు చేయాలి. National Vulture Action Plan 2020–2025 కాలానికి చెందినది. National Human–Wildlife Conflict Mitigation Strategy and Action Plan 2021–2026 కాలానికి చెందినది. National Marine Turtle Action Plan 2021–2026ను MoEFCC 2021 జనవరి 28న Marine Mega Fauna Stranding Guidelinesతో కలిసి విడుదల చేసింది. ఒక plan stated cycle ముగిసిన తరువాత కూడా ముఖ్యమైన policy recordగా ఉంటుంది; official extension లేదా successor నిర్ధారణ కాకుండా దాన్ని current planగా పేర్కొనకూడదు.

en: The International Big Cat Alliance became a treaty-based international organisation when its Framework Agreement entered into force on 23 January 2025 following ratification by five founding countries. Its membership can change as additional countries join. The much larger figure of 95 or 96 refers to countries where one or more of the seven big-cat species may occur; it is not the number of IBCA members.
te: ఐదు స్థాపక దేశాలు ఆమోదించిన తరువాత Framework Agreement 2025 జనవరి 23న అమల్లోకి రావడంతో IBCA ఒప్పంద ఆధారిత అంతర్జాతీయ సంస్థగా మారింది. మరిన్ని దేశాలు చేరినప్పుడు సభ్యత్వం మారవచ్చు. 95 లేదా 96 అనే పెద్ద సంఖ్య, ఏడు పెద్ద పిల్లిజాతుల్లో కనీసం ఒకటి కనిపించే అవకాశం ఉన్న దేశాలను సూచిస్తుంది; IBCA సభ్యదేశాల సంఖ్యను కాదు.

en: MISHTI—Mangrove Initiative for Shoreline Habitats & Tangible Incomes—was announced in the 2023–24 Union Budget on 1 February 2023 and launched on 5 June 2023. From financial year 2023–24 it set a five-year target of restoring or planting mangroves over about 540 sq km. Its 80:20 Union–State pattern works mainly through convergence with mechanisms such as MGNREGS and CAMPA. It joins coastal protection and blue-carbon storage with livelihood benefits across 13 coastal States and Union Territories; differing 11+2 or 9+4 break-ups should be attributed to their source.
te: MISHTI పూర్తి రూపం Mangrove Initiative for Shoreline Habitats & Tangible Incomes. 2023–24 Union Budgetలో 1 February 2023న announce చేసి, 5 June 2023న launch చేశారు. FY 2023–24 నుంచి five yearsలో సుమారు 540 sq km mangrovesను restore లేదా plant చేయడం target. Union–State funding pattern 80:20; implementation ప్రధానంగా MGNREGS, CAMPA వంటి mechanismsతో convergence ద్వారా సాగుతుంది. Coastal protection, blue-carbon storage, livelihoodsను 13 coastal States and Union Territoriesలో కలుపుతుంది. 11+2 లేదా 9+4 breakupను వాడితే sourceను తప్పనిసరిగా చెప్పాలి.

en: Amrit Dharohar is a three-year MoEFCC scheme for capacity building and community participation at sites that already possess Ramsar designation. Announced alongside MISHTI and launched on 5 June 2023, it applies the Ramsar principle of wise use through biodiversity conservation, carbon-stock assessment, eco-tourism, green jobs and community stewardship. It neither designates new Ramsar Sites nor replaces the Ramsar Convention.
te: Amrit Dharohar, Ramsar designation ఇప్పటికే ఉన్న sitesలో capacity building, community participation కోసం MoEFCC చేపట్టిన three-year scheme. MISHTIతో పాటు announce చేసి 5 June 2023న launch చేశారు. Biodiversity conservation, carbon-stock assessment, eco-tourism, green jobs, community stewardship ద్వారా Ramsar ‘wise use’ principleను అమలు చేస్తుంది. ఇది new Ramsar Sitesను designate చేయదు; Ramsar Conventionకు replacement కూడా కాదు.

en: IUCN categories assess global extinction risk, CITES Appendices regulate international trade and Wildlife Protection Act Schedules provide legal protection within India. Wildlife-crime institutions also have distinct functions: WCCB coordinates intelligence and links with CITES enforcement, while DRI acts against customs and smuggling offences. The CITES Management Authority and Scientific Authority likewise perform separate regulatory and scientific roles.
te: IUCN category global extinction riskను assess చేస్తుంది; CITES Appendix international tradeను regulate చేస్తుంది; Wildlife Protection Act Schedule Indiaలో legal protectionను ఇస్తుంది. Enforcement institutions roles కూడా వేరు. WCCB wildlife-crime intelligenceను coordinate చేసి CITES enforcementతో link అవుతుంది; DRI customs, smuggling offencesపై action తీసుకుంటుంది. CITES Management Authority, Scientific Authority కూడా separate regulatory, scientific functions నిర్వహిస్తాయి.

en: The Indian star tortoise was transferred to CITES Appendix I at CoP18 in 2019 in response to commercial pet trade. Red sanders has remained in Appendix II since 1994, so legal international trade is regulated rather than absolutely prohibited; illegal logging remains a separate offence. All pangolin species moved to Appendix I at CoP17 in 2016. Review of Significant Trade decisions and seizure figures are dated enforcement evidence, not permanent conservation-status labels.
te: Commercial pet tradeను curb చేయడానికి Indian star tortoiseను CITES CoP18లో 2019లో Appendix Iకు transfer చేశారు. Red sanders 1994 నుంచి Appendix IIలో ఉంది; legal international trade regulated, absolute prohibition కాదు. Illegal logging మాత్రం separate offence. అన్ని pangolin speciesను CoP17లో 2016లో Appendix Iకు మార్చారు. Review of Significant Trade decisions, seizure figures dated enforcement evidence మాత్రమే; permanent conservation-status labels కావు.

en: The International Big Cat Alliance is a treaty-based intergovernmental organisation for cooperation, knowledge sharing, capacity building, anti-trafficking practice and resource mobilisation. It is neither an Indian field-level species project nor a statutory authority under the Wildlife Protection Act. Announced on 9 April 2023, it received Union Cabinet approval on 29 February 2024 for establishment and an Indian headquarters, with ₹150 crore over five years. Its Framework Agreement entered into force on 23 January 2025 after five founding ratifications, and the Headquarters Agreement followed on 17 April 2025.
te: International Big Cat Alliance (IBCA) cooperation, knowledge sharing, capacity building, anti-trafficking practice, resource mobilisation కోసం treaty-based intergovernmental organisation. ఇది Indian field-level species project కాదు; Wildlife Protection Act కింద statutory authority కూడా కాదు. 9 April 2023న announce చేశారు. Indiaలో headquarters, five yearsకు ₹150 crore supportతో establishmentను Union Cabinet 29 February 2024న approve చేసింది. Five founding ratifications తరువాత Framework Agreement 23 January 2025న forceలోకి వచ్చింది; Headquarters Agreement 17 April 2025న జరిగింది.

en: IBCA covers tiger, lion, leopard, snow leopard, cheetah, jaguar and puma. Clouded leopard and lynx are not included. The first five occur in India, whereas jaguar and puma are native to the Americas. The figure 95 or 96 refers to potential range countries, not current members. Its first summit, planned for 1–2 June 2026, was postponed by a PIB notice dated 21 May 2026, so the planned meeting did not produce a New Delhi Declaration.
te: IBCA cover చేసే seven species: tiger, lion, leopard, snow leopard, cheetah, jaguar, puma. Clouded leopard, lynx ఈ listలో లేవు. First five Indiaలో occur అవుతాయి; jaguar, puma Americasకు native. 95 లేదా 96 అనేది potential range countries figure; current members count కాదు. 1–2 June 2026కు planned first summitను 21 May 2026 PIB notice ద్వారా postpone చేశారు. కాబట్టి planned meeting నుంచి New Delhi Declaration వచ్చిందని చెప్పడం తప్పు.

en: Operation Olivia is an annual Indian Coast Guard operation under the Ministry of Defence, not an MoEFCC project. Conducted since the early 1980s, generally from November to May off Odisha's nesting coast, it uses surface and aerial patrols, seasonal trawling restrictions and enforcement of Turtle Excluder Devices to reduce olive-ridley deaths in trawl nets. Patrol effort and turtle counts vary by season and require dates.
te: Operation Olivia, Ministry of Defence కింద Indian Coast Guard annually నిర్వహించే operation; MoEFCC project కాదు. Early 1980s నుంచి Odisha nesting coast watersలో సాధారణంగా November–May మధ్య నిర్వహిస్తున్నారు. Surface patrols, aerial patrols, seasonal trawling restrictions, Turtle Excluder Devices enforcement ద్వారా olive ridleys trawl netsలో చిక్కి మునిగే ప్రమాదాన్ని తగ్గిస్తుంది. Patrol effort, turtle counts seasonను బట్టి మారుతాయి కాబట్టి date అవసరం.

en: MoEFCC released the National Marine Turtle Action Plan 2021–2026 on 28 January 2021 together with the Marine Mega Fauna Stranding Guidelines. It coordinates threat reduction, habitat rehabilitation, response to stranding and entanglement, research and community participation across agencies. Since its stated cycle ends in 2026, a successor or extension must be verified before it is described as the current plan.
te: MoEFCC, National Marine Turtle Action Plan 2021–2026ను Marine Mega Fauna Stranding Guidelinesతో కలిసి 28 January 2021న release చేసింది. Threat reduction, habitat rehabilitation, stranding లేదా entanglement response, research, community participationను agencies మధ్య coordinate చేస్తుంది. Stated cycle 2026తో ముగుస్తుంది; successor లేదా extensionను verify చేయకుండా దీన్ని current planగా పేర్కొనకూడదు.

en: Project Hangul is a Jammu and Kashmir State initiative begun in the 1970s with IUCN and WWF support for the Critically Endangered Kashmir stag, now concentrated mainly in Dachigam National Park. Sangai is a different species: Manipur's Endangered brow-antlered deer, living on floating phumdi in Keibul Lamjao National Park on Loktak Lake. The two differ in species, State, habitat and programme history, though both demonstrate the risk of concentration at one principal site.
te: Project Hangul, 1970sలో IUCN, WWF supportతో ప్రారంభమైన Jammu and Kashmir State initiative. Critically Endangered Kashmir stag ఇప్పుడు mainly Dachigam National Parkలో concentratedగా ఉంది. Sangai వేరే species: Manipurకు చెందిన Endangered brow-antlered deer; Loktak Lakeలో floating phumdiపై ఉన్న Keibul Lamjao National Parkలో జీవిస్తుంది. Species, State, habitat, programme history అన్నీ వేరు; అయితే single principal siteలో population concentrate అవడం వల్ల వచ్చే risk రెండింటికీ common.

en: Indian Rhino Vision 2020 was a multi-partner vision launched in 2005, not a Centrally Sponsored Scheme. Returning wild rhinos to Manas, where they had disappeared locally, was reintroduction rather than reinforcement. India's first Dugong Conservation Reserve was notified on 21 September 2022 over 448.34 sq km of seagrass habitat in northern Palk Bay; it is a Conservation Reserve, not a National Park. Project Nilgiri Tahr is a Tamil Nadu State project launched in 2023, and Tamil Nadu and Kerala conducted a synchronised estimate in April 2025.
te: Indian Rhino Vision 2020, 2005లో launch చేసిన multi-partner vision; Centrally Sponsored Scheme కాదు. Rhinos locally disappear అయిన Manasకు wild animalsను తిరిగి release చేయడం reintroduction, reinforcement కాదు. India's first Dugong Conservation Reserveను northern Palk Bayలోని 448.34 sq km seagrass habitatపై 21 September 2022న notify చేశారు; legal category Conservation Reserve, National Park కాదు. Project Nilgiri Tahr 2023లో launch అయిన Tamil Nadu State project; Tamil Nadu, Kerala April 2025లో synchronised estimate నిర్వహించాయి.

en: Andhra Pradesh belongs to two biogeographic settings in the current Wildlife Institute of India (WII) scheme. Its coastal plain falls in Zone 8, the Coasts, and specifically in Province 8B, the East Coast. Parts of the Eastern Ghats fall in Zone 6, the Deccan Peninsula, and Province 6C, the Eastern Highlands. Thus, the state's coastal and deltaic habitats differ biogeographically from its hill forests.
te: ప్రస్తుత Wildlife Institute of India (WII) biogeographic schemeలో ఆంధ్రప్రదేశ్ రెండు భిన్న ప్రాంతాల్లో విస్తరించింది. రాష్ట్ర coastal plain, Coastsను సూచించే Zone 8లో ఉంది; అందులో ఇది East Coastకు చెందిన Province 8Bలో భాగం. Eastern Ghatsలోని కొన్ని ప్రాంతాలు Deccan Peninsulaను సూచించే Zone 6లో, Eastern Highlandsకు చెందిన Province 6Cలో ఉన్నాయి. అంటే రాష్ట్రంలోని coastal, delta habitats ఒక biogeographic settingకు; hill forests మరో settingకు చెందుతాయి.

en: A revised official measurement announced in April 2025 placed Andhra Pradesh's coastline at about 1,053.07 km. The often-quoted figure of roughly 974 km came from the older measurement method. The numbers belong to different methods and assessment dates, so the source or edition must be stated when either is quoted.
te: April 2025లో ప్రకటించిన revised official measurement ప్రకారం Andhra Pradesh coastline పొడవు సుమారు 1,053.07 km. తరచుగా కనిపించే సుమారు 974 km అనే పాత సంఖ్య, అంతకుముందు ఉపయోగించిన measurement methodకు చెందినది. కాబట్టి ఈ figures పరస్పర విరుద్ధం కావు; అవి వేర్వేరు methods, assessment datesకు చెందినవి. Examలో ఏ సంఖ్యను ఉపయోగించినా దాని source లేదా editionను గుర్తించాలి.

en: In the current WII scheme, Zone 8 represents the Coasts: 8A is the West Coast and 8B is the East Coast. Zone 9 represents North-East India and Zone 10 the Islands. Some older classifications used the number 10 for a coastal zone. A zone number is therefore meaningful only when read with the version that assigned it.
te: ప్రస్తుత WII schemeలో Zone 8 అంటే Coasts: 8A West Coast, 8B East Coast. Zone 9 North-East Indiaను, Zone 10 Islandsను సూచిస్తాయి. కొన్ని పాత classificationsలో coastal zoneకు 10 అనే number వాడారు. అందువల్ల zone numberను ఒక్కటే గుర్తుపెట్టుకోకుండా, అది ఏ classification versionకు చెందినదో కూడా చూడాలి.

en: The Eastern Ghats extend for roughly 1,750 km and cover about 75,000 km². Andhra Pradesh is commonly estimated to contain the largest state-wise share—nearly 40% of the range—and the Ghats occupy roughly one-fourth to one-third of the state's area. These are broad regional estimates, not exact measurements derived from one gazetted boundary.
te: Eastern Ghats సుమారు 1,750 km పొడవున విస్తరించి, దాదాపు 75,000 km² ప్రాంతాన్ని కవర్ చేస్తాయి. ఈ mountain rangeలో state-wiseగా అత్యధిక భాగం Andhra Pradeshలో ఉందని, అది దాదాపు 40% అని సాధారణంగా అంచనా వేస్తారు. రాష్ట్ర విస్తీర్ణంలో Eastern Ghats వాటా సుమారు నాలుగో వంతు నుంచి మూడో వంతు వరకు ఉండవచ్చు. ఇవి broad regional estimates మాత్రమే; ఒకే gazetted boundary ఆధారంగా చేసిన exact measurements కావు.

en: The Eastern Ghats are generally lower, drier and more discontinuous than the Western Ghats. Rivers such as the Godavari and Krishna cut across them. In Andhra Pradesh, important ranges include Nallamala, Seshachalam, Palakonda, Velikonda and Papikonda. Vegetation changes from moist deciduous to dry deciduous forest; unlike the Western Ghats, there is no single long, continuous wet-evergreen belt.
te: Western Ghatsతో పోలిస్తే Eastern Ghats సాధారణంగా తక్కువ ఎత్తులో, ఎక్కువ పొడిగా, మధ్యమధ్యలో విడిపోయిన rangesగా ఉంటాయి. Godavari, Krishna వంటి rivers వీటిని దాటి ప్రవహిస్తాయి. Andhra Pradeshలో Nallamala, Seshachalam, Palakonda, Velikonda, Papikonda ముఖ్యమైన ranges. ఇక్కడ vegetation moist deciduous forest నుంచి dry deciduous forest వరకు మారుతుంది. Western Ghatsలో ఉన్నట్లుగా ఒక పొడవైన, continuous wet evergreen forest belt ఇక్కడ కనిపించదు.

en: Rayalaseema forms Andhra Pradesh's dry interior. It receives less rainfall, partly because of a rain-shadow effect, and its characteristic habitats are semi-arid thorn scrub and dry grassland. These are distinct open ecosystems, not merely degraded or unfinished versions of deciduous hill forest.
te: Rayalaseema, Andhra Pradeshలోని dry interior region. Rain-shadow effectతో పాటు ఇతర climatic factors వల్ల ఇక్కడ rainfall తక్కువగా ఉంటుంది. అందుకే semi-arid thorn scrub, dry grassland ప్రధాన habitatsగా కనిపిస్తాయి. ఇవి ప్రత్యేకమైన open ecosystems; deciduous hill forest క్షీణించి ఏర్పడిన ఖాళీ భూములు కావు.

en: Ananthapuramu shows how several pressures combine to cause desertification. Low and irregular rainfall, severe aridity, declining tree cover and soil carbon, excessive groundwater extraction and wind erosion reinforce one another. Tree cover means tree-covered area outside recorded forests, whereas forest cover is identified through prescribed area and canopy criteria irrespective of legal status. The measures are not interchangeable, and each estimate belongs to a stated assessment period.
te: Ananthapuramuలో desertification ఒకే కారణంతో కాదు; అనేక pressures కలిసి పనిచేయడం వల్ల పెరుగుతుంది. తక్కువ, irregular rainfall; తీవ్రమైన aridity; తగ్గుతున్న tree cover, soil carbon; excessive groundwater extraction; wind erosion—ఇవన్నీ కలిసి land degradationను వేగవంతం చేస్తాయి. Recorded forest areas బయట చెట్లు కప్పిన ప్రాంతాన్ని tree cover అంటారు. Legal statusతో సంబంధం లేకుండా, నిర్ణీత area, canopy criteriaకు సరిపడే ప్రాంతాన్ని forest coverగా గుర్తిస్తారు. కాబట్టి ఈ measures ఒకటే కావు; ప్రతి figureను దాని assessment periodతో కలిపి చదవాలి.

en: Rollapadu lies in Rayalaseema's dry-grassland landscape and historically supported the Great Indian Bustard. When this landscape is converted or degraded, the lost habitat is open grassland and scrub—not deciduous forest. A native grassland is a complete ecosystem; treating it as vacant land and planting unsuitable trees can damage, rather than restore, it.
te: Rollapadu, Rayalaseema dry-grassland landscapeలో ఉంది; చారిత్రకంగా Great Indian Bustardకు habitatగా ఉండేది. ఈ ప్రాంతం conversion లేదా degradationకు గురైతే నష్టపోయేది deciduous forest కాదు—open grassland, scrub habitat. Native grassland కూడా స్వతంత్రంగా పనిచేసే పూర్తి ecosystem. దాన్ని vacant landగా భావించి unsuitable trees నాటితే restoration కాకుండా ecological damage జరగవచ్చు.

en: Ecological restoration must match the ecosystem. In the dry interior, it may mean protecting native grassland and thorn scrub from conversion and avoiding unsuitable tree planting. On the coast, restoring mangroves and palmyra belts can reduce exposure to cyclones and erosion. Restoration across Andhra Pradesh should not be reduced to one uniform afforestation formula.
te: Ecological restoration అక్కడి ecosystem స్వభావానికి సరిపోవాలి. Dry interiorలో native grassland, thorn scrubను conversion నుంచి కాపాడటం, unsuitable tree plantingను నివారించడం restoration కావచ్చు. Coastలో mangroves, palmyra beltsను పునరుద్ధరించడం cyclones, erosion ప్రభావాన్ని తగ్గించగలదు. అందువల్ల Andhra Pradesh అంతటా restorationను ఒకే uniform afforestation formulaగా అమలు చేయకూడదు.

en: On the reference date used for these figures, Andhra Pradesh had three National Parks and thirteen Wildlife Sanctuaries, but no notified Community Reserve or Conservation Reserve. Nagarjunasagar–Srisailam is also a Tiger Reserve, yet that designation overlaps existing protected areas and does not create an additional National Park or Sanctuary. These totals are date-sensitive.
te: ఈ figuresకు సంబంధించిన reference date నాటికి Andhra Pradeshలో 3 National Parks, 13 Wildlife Sanctuaries ఉన్నాయి; notified Community Reserve లేదా Conservation Reserve లేదు. Nagarjunasagar–Srisailamకు Tiger Reserve status కూడా ఉంది. అయితే అది ఇప్పటికే ఉన్న protected areasపై overlap అవుతుంది; అందువల్ల దాన్ని అదనపు National Park లేదా Sanctuaryగా లెక్కించరు. Protected-area totals date-sensitive కాబట్టి కొత్త notifications తర్వాత verify చేయాలి.

en: Two Andhra Pradesh protected areas carry the name Rajiv Gandhi, but they are different sites. Rajiv Gandhi National Park is a small park at Rameswaram beside the Penna in YSR Kadapa district. Rajiv Gandhi Wildlife Sanctuary is a much larger protected area in the Nallamala landscape and forms part of NSTR. Legal category and location are the safest distinctions.
te: Andhra Pradeshలో Rajiv Gandhi పేరుతో రెండు protected areas ఉన్నాయి; అవి ఒకే site కావు. YSR Kadapa districtలో Penna పక్కన Rameswaram వద్ద ఉన్న చిన్న ప్రాంతం Rajiv Gandhi National Park. Nallamala landscapeలో ఉన్న పెద్ద ప్రాంతం Rajiv Gandhi Wildlife Sanctuary; ఇది NSTRలో భాగం. Examలో వీటిని legal category, location ఆధారంగా వేరు చేయాలి.

en: Papikonda National Park protects Eastern Ghats forest along the Godavari gorge. Submergence and altered river flow associated with the Polavaram project can affect riverside forest and interrupt wildlife movement routes. The ecological concern extends beyond directly submerged land to possible weakening of north–south habitat connectivity.
te: Godavari gorge వెంట ఉన్న Eastern Ghats forestను Papikonda National Park రక్షిస్తుంది. Polavaram projectతో సంబంధమున్న submergence, altered river flow వల్ల riverside forest దెబ్బతిని, wildlife movement routesకు అంతరాయం కలగవచ్చు. కాబట్టి ecological concern నేరుగా మునిగే landకే పరిమితం కాదు; north–south habitat connectivity బలహీనపడే అవకాశం కూడా ఇందులో ఉంది.

en: Andhra Pradesh wildlife sites do not all have the same legal status or purpose. Nelapattu is a notified Wildlife Sanctuary known for its pelican breeding colony. Telineelapuram and Telukunchi are recognised bird areas, but not Wildlife Sanctuaries. Koundinya protects part of a three-state elephant landscape, while Kambalakonda conserves forest beside Visakhapatnam city. A site name must be read with its legal category and conservation role.
te: Andhra Pradeshలో wildlife sites అన్నింటికీ ఒకే legal status లేదా purpose ఉండదు. Nelapattu, pelican breeding colonyకి ప్రసిద్ధి చెందిన notified Wildlife Sanctuary. Telineelapuram, Telukunchi గుర్తింపు పొందిన bird areas; కానీ Wildlife Sanctuaries కావు. మూడు statesలో విస్తరించిన elephant landscapeలో ఒక భాగాన్ని Koundinya రక్షిస్తుంది. Visakhapatnam city పక్కనున్న forestను Kambalakonda సంరక్షిస్తుంది. అందువల్ల site nameతో పాటు legal category, conservation roleను కూడా గుర్తించాలి.

en: Rollapadu Wildlife Sanctuary was established chiefly to conserve the Great Indian Bustard, but its present association with the bird is largely historical. A WII study published in 2026 modelled habitat suitability; it was not a field census and did not establish a zero population at Rollapadu. Available evidence suggests the bustard is no longer observed locally, but formally declaring local extinction needs stronger, sustained survey evidence.
te: Great Indian Bustard conservation ప్రధాన లక్ష్యంగా Rollapadu Wildlife Sanctuary ఏర్పడింది. అయితే ప్రస్తుతం sanctuaryతో ఆ birdకు ఉన్న సంబంధం ఎక్కువగా historical. 2026లో ప్రచురితమైన WII study habitat suitabilityని model చేసింది; అది field census కాదు, Rollapadu population zero అని నిర్ధారించలేదు. ప్రస్తుతం bustard స్థానికంగా కనిపించడం లేదని available evidence సూచిస్తుంది. కానీ local extinctionను formally declare చేయాలంటే stronger, sustained survey evidence అవసరం.

en: Nagarjunasagar–Srisailam Tiger Reserve (NSTR) lies entirely within present-day Andhra Pradesh and covers about 3,728 km², making it India's largest Tiger Reserve by area. It includes roughly 2,444.14 km² of core and 1,283.36 km² of buffer. NSTR overlaps Rajiv Gandhi and Gundla Brahmeswaram Wildlife Sanctuaries, showing how Tiger Reserve status can add a management layer over existing protected areas.
te: Nagarjunasagar–Srisailam Tiger Reserve (NSTR) ప్రస్తుతం పూర్తిగా Andhra Pradeshలోనే ఉంది. దీని area సుమారు 3,728 km²; area పరంగా ఇది Indiaలో largest Tiger Reserveగా పేర్కొనబడుతుంది. ఇందులో సుమారు 2,444.14 km² core, 1,283.36 km² buffer ఉన్నాయి. NSTR, Rajiv Gandhi మరియు Gundla Brahmeswaram Wildlife Sanctuariesపై overlap అవుతుంది. అంటే ఇప్పటికే ఉన్న protected areasపై Tiger Reserve status అదనపు management layerగా పనిచేయగలదు.

en: When the Tiger Reserve was created in 1983, its landscape lay in undivided Andhra Pradesh. After state bifurcation in 2014, Telangana separately notified its portion as Amrabad Tiger Reserve in 2015. NSTR now lies wholly in Andhra Pradesh, but continuous Nallamala forest keeps the two reserves ecologically connected across the state boundary.
te: 1983లో Tiger Reserve ఏర్పడినప్పుడు దాని landscape undivided Andhra Pradeshలో ఉండేది. 2014 state bifurcation తర్వాత, Telangana తన భాగాన్ని 2015లో Amrabad Tiger Reserveగా విడిగా notify చేసింది. ఇప్పుడు NSTR పూర్తిగా Andhra Pradeshలో ఉంది. అయినప్పటికీ continuous Nallamala forest వల్ల NSTR, Amrabad state boundaryకు అవతల కూడా ecologically connectedగా ఉన్నాయి.

en: The 2022 All India Tiger Estimation (AITE) estimated 63 tigers for Andhra Pradesh as a whole—not for NSTR alone. The same assessment reported local extinction of tigers in Sri Venkateswara National Park. Both findings belong to the 2022 assessment cycle and may be superseded by a later official state table.
te: 2022 All India Tiger Estimation (AITE), Andhra Pradesh మొత్తం రాష్ట్రానికి 63 tigers ఉన్నట్లు estimate చేసింది; అది NSTRకు మాత్రమే చెందిన count కాదు. అదే assessment, Sri Venkateswara National Parkలో tigers local extinctionను report చేసింది. ఈ రెండు findings 2022 assessment cycleకు చెందినవి; తర్వాతి official state table వచ్చినప్పుడు మారవచ్చు.

en: Sources do not provide one uncontested NSTR tiger figure for 2024. The Andhra Pradesh Forest Department annual report gives 76, while another camera-trap-based account gives 87 and discusses tigers not detected again and an NTCA inquiry. These separate source-specific figures must not be merged. The next official AITE result will provide a common benchmark.
te: 2024కు NSTR tiger populationపై sourcesలో ఒకే uncontested figure లేదు. Andhra Pradesh Forest Department annual report 76 అని చెబుతుంది. మరో camera-trap-based account 87 అని పేర్కొని, మళ్లీ detect కాని tigers, NTCA inquiry గురించి చర్చిస్తుంది. ఇవి వేర్వేరు sourcesకు చెందిన figures; వాటిని కలిపి ఒకే estimateగా చూపకూడదు. తదుపరి official AITE result common benchmark ఇస్తుంది.

en: Recorded movement of male tigers between NSTR and Amrabad shows that the Nallamala forest still functions as one connected ecological landscape, although the reserves are administered by different states. The forest is also home to the Chenchu, a Particularly Vulnerable Tribal Group (PVTG). Conservation must maintain corridors while respecting community rights recognised under the Forest Rights Act (FRA).
te: NSTR, Amrabad మధ్య male tigers movement record కావడం, రెండు reservesను వేర్వేరు states manage చేసినా Nallamala forest ఒక connected ecological landscapeగా పనిచేస్తోందని చూపుతుంది. ఈ forest, Particularly Vulnerable Tribal Group (PVTG)కు చెందిన Chenchu ప్రజల నివాసం కూడా. అందువల్ల conservation, wildlife corridorsను functionalగా ఉంచడంతో పాటు Forest Rights Act (FRA) గుర్తించిన community rightsను గౌరవించాలి.

en: India designated Seshachalam as a Biosphere Reserve on 20 September 2010, covering about 4,756 km². It has not been inscribed in UNESCO's World Network of Biosphere Reserves. National designation and UNESCO inscription are separate processes. Likewise, a proposed Biosphere Reserve remains only a proposal until formal approval.
te: India, 20 September 2010న సుమారు 4,756 km² areaతో Seshachalamను Biosphere Reserveగా designate చేసింది. అయితే ఇది UNESCO World Network of Biosphere Reservesలో inscribe కాలేదు. National designation, UNESCO inscription రెండు separate processes. అలాగే మరో Biosphere Reserveకు proposal పంపినా formal approval వచ్చే వరకు అది proposal మాత్రమే.

en: Tirumala Tirupati Devasthanams (TTD) works with the Forest Department in managing parts of Seshachalam forest and its valuable red-sanders resources. This is a distinctive local institutional arrangement. Bairluty is different: it is the site of a wildlife rescue centre in the NSTR–Nallamala landscape, not another name for Seshachalam.
te: Seshachalam forestలోని కొన్ని parts, valuable red-sanders resources managementలో Tirumala Tirupati Devasthanams (TTD), Forest Departmentతో కలిసి పనిచేస్తుంది. ఇది local institutional arrangement. Bairluty మాత్రం దీనికి మరో పేరు కాదు; అది NSTR–Nallamala landscapeలో wildlife rescue centre ఉన్న location.

en: Red sanders is endemic to the southern Eastern Ghats: its natural distribution is restricted to this region. A native species occurs naturally in a region but need not be confined to it, so native and endemic are not synonyms. Red sanders is in CITES Appendix II; international trade is regulated through permits, not automatically prohibited in every legal circumstance. Andhra Pradesh's joint Police–Forest task force acts against illegal felling and smuggling in the Seshachalam–Velikonda belt.
te: Red sanders southern Eastern Ghatsకు endemic; అంటే దాని natural distribution ఈ limited geographical regionకే పరిమితం. Native species ఒక regionలో సహజంగా ఉండవచ్చు, కానీ అక్కడికే పరిమితం కావాల్సిన అవసరం లేదు. కాబట్టి native, endemic ఒకే అర్థం కాదు. Red sanders CITES Appendix IIలో ఉంది; international trade permits ద్వారా regulate అవుతుంది, ప్రతి legal circumstanceలో automatic ban కాదు. Andhra Pradeshలో joint Police–Forest task force, Seshachalam–Velikonda beltలో illegal felling, smugglingను అడ్డుకుంటుంది.

en: Kolleru is a shallow, seasonal freshwater floodplain lake between the Godavari and Krishna deltas. The Budameru and Tammileru bring water into it, while the Upputeru carries water away. By temporarily storing floodwater, the lake moderates floods and supports large numbers of wintering waterbirds. Ramsar designation recognises these existing ecological functions; it did not create them.
te: Godavari, Krishna deltas మధ్య Kolleru అనే shallow, seasonal freshwater floodplain lake ఉంది. Budameru, Tammileru streams ద్వారా దీనికి నీరు చేరి, Upputeru ద్వారా బయటకు వెళుతుంది. Floodwaterను కొంతకాలం నిల్వచేయడం వల్ల వరద తీవ్రత తగ్గుతుంది; winter seasonలో పెద్ద సంఖ్యలో waterbirdsకు habitat లభిస్తుంది. Ramsar designation ఈ ecological functionsను గుర్తించింది; వాటిని కొత్తగా సృష్టించలేదు.

en: The area figures used for Kolleru answer different questions. Its Ramsar site covers 90,100 hectares, whereas the notified Wildlife Sanctuary covers 308 km². The lake's actual water spread is not fixed and changes by season. A proposed boundary change has no legal effect until the prescribed process is completed; therefore a proposal and a notified boundary must not be treated as the same stage.
te: Kolleruకు చెప్పే area figures వేర్వేరు questionsకు సమాధానాలు. Ramsar site విస్తీర్ణం 90,100 hectares; notified Wildlife Sanctuary విస్తీర్ణం 308 km². Lakeలో actual water spread మాత్రం seasonను బట్టి మారుతుంది. Prescribed process పూర్తయ్యే వరకు proposed boundary changeకు legal effect ఉండదు. కాబట్టి proposalను notified boundaryగా భావించకూడదు.

en: Pulicat is a brackish-water lagoon separated from the Bay of Bengal by the Sriharikota barrier island. Tidal exchange with the sea creates a salinity gradient that varies across the lagoon and through time. Mudflats and seagrass beds support fish and waterbirds. Pulicat is therefore not the same kind of wetland as Kolleru, which is a freshwater floodplain lake.
te: Pulicat ఒక brackish-water lagoon. Sriharikota barrier island దీన్ని Bay of Bengal నుంచి వేరు చేస్తుంది. Tidesతో seawater లోపలికి, బయటకు కదలడం వల్ల lagoonలో ప్రాంతాన్ని, కాలాన్ని బట్టి మారే salinity gradient ఏర్పడుతుంది. Mudflats, seagrass beds చేపలు, waterbirdsకు habitat ఇస్తాయి. అందువల్ల Pulicat, freshwater floodplain lake అయిన Kolleruతో ఒకే రకమైన wetland కాదు.

en: Pulicat is not listed as an Indian Ramsar site in the current Ramsar Sites Information Service. Its legal protection instead comes from separate Wildlife Sanctuary notifications in Andhra Pradesh and Tamil Nadu; it is also recognised as an Important Bird and Biodiversity Area. This distinction shows that Ramsar status, statutory protection and biodiversity recognition are separate classifications.
te: Current Ramsar Sites Information Service listలో Pulicatను Indian Ramsar siteగా చూపలేదు. దీనికి legal protection Andhra Pradesh, Tamil Nadu జారీ చేసిన separate Wildlife Sanctuary notifications ద్వారా వస్తుంది; Important Bird and Biodiversity Areaగా కూడా దీనికి గుర్తింపు ఉంది. అంటే Ramsar status, statutory protection, biodiversity recognition మూడు వేర్వేరు classifications.

en: Pulicat and Kolleru face conversion of natural wetland into fish or shrimp ponds, nutrient-rich agricultural runoff and reduced freshwater inflow. Reduced inflow changes Kolleru's water level and disturbs Pulicat's salinity gradient. The Wetlands Rules, 2017 exclude ponds constructed specifically for aquaculture from the wetland definition; this can complicate regulation after a natural wetland has already been converted into such ponds.
te: Natural wetlandను fish లేదా shrimp pondsగా మార్చడం, nutrient-rich agricultural runoff, freshwater inflow తగ్గడం Pulicat, Kolleru ఎదుర్కొనే ప్రధాన pressures. Inflow తగ్గితే Kolleru water level మారుతుంది; Pulicatలో lagoon community ఆధారపడే salinity gradient దెబ్బతింటుంది. Aquaculture కోసమే నిర్మించిన pondsను Wetlands Rules, 2017లో wetland definition నుంచి మినహాయించారు. Natural wetland ఇప్పటికే అలాంటి pondsగా మారిన తర్వాత regulation అమలు చేయడం దీనివల్ల క్లిష్టమవుతుంది.

en: ISFR 2023 estimated Andhra Pradesh's mangrove cover at 421.43 km², up from 408.42 km² in ISFR 2021. On the all-India comparison of states and Union Territories, Andhra Pradesh ranked fourth. Among mainland east-coast states alone, it ranked second after West Bengal. These are assessment-cycle results and must always be quoted with the relevant ISFR edition.
te: ISFR 2023 ప్రకారం Andhra Pradesh mangrove cover 421.43 km²; ISFR 2021లో అది 408.42 km². States, Union Territories అన్నింటినీ కలిపిన all-India comparisonలో Andhra Pradesh నాలుగో స్థానంలో ఉంది. Mainland east-coast statesను మాత్రమే పోలిస్తే West Bengal తర్వాత రెండో స్థానంలో ఉంది. ఇవి assessment-cycle results కాబట్టి ISFR editionతో కలిపే quote చేయాలి.

en: Coringa Wildlife Sanctuary hosts India's first radio-collaring study of the fishing cat, conducted jointly by the Wildlife Institute of India and the Andhra Pradesh Forest Department. The fishing cat (Prionailurus viverrinus) is Vulnerable on the IUCN Red List and receives India's highest tier of legal wildlife protection. Its semi-aquatic adaptations allow it to hunt in wetlands. Tracking this leading mammalian predator in the Godavari mangroves helps reveal how the wetland food web uses the landscape.
te: Indiaలో fishing catపై మొదటి radio-collaring study Coringa Wildlife Sanctuaryలో జరుగుతోంది. Wildlife Institute of India, Andhra Pradesh Forest Department కలిసి దీన్ని చేపట్టాయి. Fishing cat (Prionailurus viverrinus) IUCN Red Listలో Vulnerable; Indian wildlife lawలో highest protection tier పొందుతుంది. Semi-aquatic adaptations వల్ల wetlandsలో వేటాడగలదు. Godavari mangrovesలో ఈ leading mammalian predator movementను track చేస్తే wetland food web landscapeను ఎలా ఉపయోగిస్తుందో తెలుసుకోవచ్చు.

en: A survey by Tripathy, Shanker and Choudhury, published in Oryx in 2003, provides an important baseline for olive ridley nesting in Andhra Pradesh. From November 2000 to April 2001 it recorded about 4,000 nests, many near river mouths. Nest density was about 60–100 per kilometre on the northern and central coast but 15–20 per kilometre in the south. The authors therefore described Andhra Pradesh as a dispersed-nesting coast on the migration route towards Odisha, not as a mass-nesting coast.
te: Tripathy, Shanker, Choudhury survey 2003లో Oryxలో ప్రచురితమైంది; Andhra Pradesh olive ridley nestingకు ఇది ముఖ్యమైన baseline. November 2000–April 2001 మధ్య సుమారు 4,000 nests నమోదయ్యాయి; చాలా nests river mouths దగ్గర ఉన్నాయి. Northern, central coastలో kilometreకు 60–100 nests ఉండగా, southలో 15–20 మాత్రమే ఉన్నాయి. అందువల్ల Andhra Pradeshను mass-nesting coastగా కాక, Odisha వైపు migration routeలో ఉన్న dispersed-nesting coastగా authors పేర్కొన్నారు.

en: The Great Green Wall of Andhra Pradesh is a coastal bioshield programme. It restores and establishes mangroves and palmyra belts so that natural vegetation can reduce damage from cyclones, storm surges and coastal erosion. Despite the similar name, it is not Africa's Great Green Wall: the Andhra Pradesh programme builds coastal resilience, while the African initiative addresses land degradation and desertification across the dry Sahel.
te: Great Green Wall of Andhra Pradesh ఒక coastal bioshield programme. Mangroves, palmyra beltsను restore చేసి, కొత్తగా పెంచడం ద్వారా cyclones, storm surges, coastal erosion వల్ల కలిగే నష్టాన్ని natural vegetation తగ్గించాలనేది దీని లక్ష్యం. పేరు ఒకేలా ఉన్నా ఇది Africa Great Green Wall కాదు. Andhra Pradesh programme coastal resilienceను పెంచుతుంది; African initiative dry Sahelలో land degradation, desertificationను ఎదుర్కొంటుంది.

en: Reports released in 2026 said that more than 13 lakh palmyra seeds had been collected against an initial target of five lakh, and more than 1.65 lakh planted during the season. Reported mangrove restoration covered 740 hectares in 2024–25 and 1,930 hectares in 2025–26. These are dated implementation figures, not permanent ecological outcomes: planting totals, survival and field verification must be distinguished.
te: 2026 reports ప్రకారం initial target ఐదు లక్షల palmyra seeds కాగా 13 లక్షలకు పైగా సేకరించారు; seasonలో 1.65 లక్షలకు పైగా నాటారు. Mangrove restoration 2024–25లో 740 hectares, 2025–26లో 1,930 hectaresలో జరిగినట్లు report చేశారు. ఇవి dated implementation figures మాత్రమే; permanent ecological outcomes కావు. Seeds collection, planting, survival, field verification అన్నింటినీ వేర్వేరుగా చూడాలి.

en: In 2025 scientists formally described Hemiphyllodactylus venkatadri from the Tirumala–Seshachalam region as a species new to science. A taxonomic study separated it from known species, assigned a scientific name and published its diagnostic description. This is not a rediscovery: rediscovery means finding again a species that had already been scientifically described but had gone unrecorded for a long period.
te: 2025లో Tirumala–Seshachalam region నుంచి Hemiphyllodactylus venkatadriని scientists species new to scienceగా formally describe చేశారు. Taxonomic study దాన్ని known species నుంచి వేరు చేసి, scientific name ఇచ్చి, diagnostic descriptionను publish చేసింది. ఇది rediscovery కాదు. Already described species చాలాకాలం record కాకుండా ఉండి మళ్లీ కనిపిస్తే దాన్ని rediscovery అంటారు.

en: Cycas beddomei and red sanders are both endemic to the southern Eastern Ghats, but their trade-control categories differ: Cycas beddomei is in CITES Appendix I and red sanders in Appendix II. Cycas seshachalamensis has an even narrower known range. It was described as a species new to science in 2016 from the Seshachalam foothills of the Tirupati–Chittoor tract, at roughly 200–600 metres elevation; its name refers to the Seshachalam range.
te: Cycas beddomei, red sanders రెండూ southern Eastern Ghatsకు endemic. అయితే trade-control categories వేరు: Cycas beddomei CITES Appendix Iలో, red sanders Appendix IIలో ఉన్నాయి. Cycas seshachalamensis known range ఇంకా చిన్నది. Tirupati–Chittoor tractలోని Seshachalam foothillsలో సుమారు 200–600 metres elevation నుంచి దీనిని 2016లో species new to scienceగా describe చేశారు. Seshachalam range ఆధారంగానే scientific name వచ్చింది.

en: A conservation category is meaningful only when its issuing authority is identified. Cycas beddomei's Endangered status comes from a published IUCN Red List assessment. The Critically Endangered status suggested for Cycas seshachalamensis was proposed by the authors of its species-description paper after applying IUCN criteria; it is not a formal IUCN listing. Both indicate concern, but they do not have the same official standing.
te: Conservation categoryతో పాటు దాన్ని ఇచ్చిన authorityని కూడా చూడాలి. Cycas beddomei Endangered status published IUCN Red List assessment నుంచి వచ్చింది. Cycas seshachalamensisకు Critically Endangered statusను species-description paper authors IUCN criteria apply చేసి propose చేశారు; అది formal IUCN listing కాదు. రెండూ conservation concernను చూపినా వాటి official standing ఒకటే కాదు.

en: Jerdon's Courser is Critically Endangered and has been confirmed only in a narrow scrub-forest belt of the Andhra Pradesh Eastern Ghats; no population has been verified elsewhere. Its entire confirmed global range is therefore concentrated in a small habitat within one state, making it a clear example of point endemism. Red sanders and the Venkatadri gecko are additional Andhra Pradesh examples of geographically restricted natural ranges.
te: Jerdon's Courser Critically Endangered. Andhra Pradesh Eastern Ghatsలోని narrow scrub-forest beltలో మాత్రమే ఇది confirmed అయింది; elsewhere population verify కాలేదు. అంటే entire confirmed global range ఒకే stateలోని small habitatలో కేంద్రీకృతమై ఉంది. అందువల్ల ఇది point endemismకు స్పష్టమైన example. Red sanders, Venkatadri gecko కూడా geographically restricted rangesకు Andhra Pradesh examples.

en: In September 2025, BirdLife International and Mongabay India reported a possible acoustic indication of Jerdon's Courser in the Lankamalla Hills after about two decades without a confirmed record. Because the call was recorded outside Sri Lankamalleswara Wildlife Sanctuary, it suggested that the species' surviving range might extend beyond the previously known site. The report remained provisional because it had not yet been established through a peer-reviewed scientific paper; it must not be called a confirmed rediscovery or a final range revision.
te: September 2025లో BirdLife International, Mongabay India reports ప్రకారం Lankamalla Hillsలో Jerdon's Courser call కావచ్చని ఒక acoustic indication నమోదైంది. దాదాపు రెండు దశాబ్దాలుగా confirmed record లేని నేపథ్యంలో ఇది ముఖ్యమైన report. ఆ sound Sri Lankamalleswara Wildlife Sanctuary బయట record కావడంతో species range గతంలో తెలిసిన siteను మించి ఉండవచ్చని సూచించింది. కానీ peer-reviewed scientific paper ద్వారా ఇది ఇంకా establish కాలేదు. కాబట్టి దీన్ని confirmed rediscoveryగా లేదా final range revisionగా చెప్పకూడదు.

en: The Andhra Pradesh State Biodiversity Board forwarded proposals to recognise Veerapuram and Timmamma Marrimanu as Biodiversity Heritage Sites. A proposal or recommendation does not itself create legal status. A site becomes a notified Biodiversity Heritage Site only when the competent government completes the prescribed process and issues a Gazette notification. Until then it must be described as proposed, not notified.
te: Veerapuram, Timmamma Marrimanuలను Biodiversity Heritage Sitesగా recognise చేయాలనే proposalsను Andhra Pradesh State Biodiversity Board forward చేసింది. Proposal లేదా recommendation వల్ల వెంటనే legal status రాదు. Competent government prescribed process పూర్తిచేసి Gazette notification issue చేసిన తర్వాతే notified Biodiversity Heritage Site అవుతుంది. అప్పటి వరకు వాటిని proposed sitesగానే చెప్పాలి; notified sitesగా కాదు.

en: Community-protected sacred groves in Andhra Pradesh are commonly called Pavithravanams. Because they conserve species in their natural habitat, they are a form of in-situ conservation. They are customary community-protected places, however, not statutory protected areas such as national parks or wildlife sanctuaries. About 730 have been documented across the state, many in the Eastern Ghats; this is an approximate inventory, not an exhaustive legal count.
te: Andhra Pradeshలో communities కాపాడే sacred grovesను సాధారణంగా Pavithravanams అంటారు. Speciesను natural habitatలోనే conserve చేస్తాయి కాబట్టి ఇవి in-situ conservation. అయితే ఇవి customary community-protected places; National Parks, Wildlife Sanctuaries వంటి statutory protected areas కావు. Stateలో సుమారు 730 groves document అయ్యాయి; వాటిలో చాలా Eastern Ghatsలో ఉన్నాయి. ఇది approximate inventory మాత్రమే; exhaustive legal count కాదు.

en: Borra Caves and the Borra sacred grove are in the same locality but are not the same feature. The caves are a limestone karst system in the Ananthagiri–Araku tract; the sacred grove is a separate community-protected forest patch beside the cave and shrine complex. A 2021 study recorded 31 tree species in 28 genera and 20 families, with Combretaceae contributing the most species. Older Visakhapatnam and current Alluri Sitharama Raju district references reflect the 2022 district reorganisation, not different sites.
te: Borra Caves, Borra sacred grove ఒకే localityలో ఉన్నా ఒకే feature కాదు. Ananthagiri–Araku tract limestoneలో ఏర్పడిన karst system Borra Caves; cave, shrine complex పక్కన community protect చేసే separate forest patch Borra sacred grove. 2021 studyలో 20 families, 28 generaకు చెందిన 31 tree species record అయ్యాయి; Combretaceaeలో అత్యధిక species ఉన్నాయి. Older sourcesలో Visakhapatnam, current referencesలో Alluri Sitharama Raju district కనిపించడం 2022 district reorganisation వల్ల; అవి different sites కావు.

en: Andhra Pradesh launched Project H.A.N.U.M.A.N. on World Wildlife Day, 3 March 2026, to respond to human–wildlife conflict and rescue injured or stranded animals. At launch it had 100 GPS-enabled vehicles—93 response vehicles and seven ambulances—four treatment centres at Visakhapatnam, Rajamahendravaram, Tirupati and Bairluty, AI-assisted warnings and Vajra response teams. These launch-stage numbers are dated; different conflicts still require different preventive measures.
te: World Wildlife Day అయిన 3 March 2026న Andhra Pradesh Project H.A.N.U.M.A.N.ను launch చేసింది. Human–wildlife conflictకు response ఇవ్వడం, injured లేదా stranded animalsను rescue చేయడం దీని purpose. Launch సమయంలో 100 GPS-enabled vehicles—93 response vehicles, 7 ambulances—ఉన్నాయి. Visakhapatnam, Rajamahendravaram, Tirupati, Bairlutyలో 4 treatment centres, AI-assisted warnings, Vajra response teams కూడా ఉన్నాయి. ఇవి launch-stage dated figures; అన్ని conflictsకు ఒకే preventive measure సరిపోదు.

en: In the three-tier NBA–SBB–BMC framework, the Andhra Pradesh State Biodiversity Board operates at state level. Panchayats and municipalities constitute Biodiversity Management Committees, which prepare People's Biodiversity Registers documenting local biological resources and associated traditional knowledge. Tiger-reserve management additionally involves the Forest Department, NTCA and sometimes neighbouring states. Biodiversity governance is therefore a network of shared responsibilities, not one administrative chain.
te: Three-tier NBA–SBB–BMC frameworkలో Andhra Pradesh State Biodiversity Board state levelలో పనిచేస్తుంది. Panchayats, municipalities Biodiversity Management Committeesను constitute చేస్తాయి. Local biological resources, వాటితో సంబంధమున్న traditional knowledgeను document చేసే People's Biodiversity Registersను BMCs prepare చేస్తాయి. Tiger Reserve managementలో Forest Department, NTCA, అవసరమైతే neighbouring states కూడా ఉంటాయి. కాబట్టి biodiversity governance ఒక single administrative chain కాదు; shared responsibilities network.

en: The Andhra Pradesh State Wetland Authority implements the Wetlands Rules at state level. G.O.Rt.No.89 of 24 October 2019 reconstituted it after an earlier 2016 order. Under the prescribed structure, the State Minister is chairperson and the senior environment secretary vice-chairperson; the 2019 order gave the body a three-year term. Its membership list therefore describes that reconstitution period, not necessarily the authority's present composition.
te: Andhra Pradesh State Wetland Authority state levelలో Wetlands Rulesను implement చేస్తుంది. Earlier 2016 order తర్వాత 24 October 2019 నాటి G.O.Rt.No.89 ద్వారా authorityను reconstitute చేశారు. Prescribed structureలో State Minister chairperson, senior environment secretary vice-chairperson; 2019 orderలో term మూడు సంవత్సరాలు. కాబట్టి ఆ membership list ఆ reconstitution periodకు చెందింది; current composition అని తప్పనిసరిగా భావించకూడదు.

en: The Andhra Pradesh Coastal Zone Management Authority appraises proposals under the CRZ framework and prepares or forwards the State's Coastal Zone Management Plans. In June 2026 it recommended reclassifying the Madhurawada–Bheemunipatnam stretch from CRZ-III B to CRZ-II. NCZMA minutes of 8 May 2026 recorded that the Andhra Pradesh CRZ-2019 plan was still pending: hearings were complete in 12 of 13 coastal districts, with Visakhapatnam remaining. These are dated administrative stages, not permanent status statements.
te: Andhra Pradesh Coastal Zone Management Authority CRZ frameworkలో proposalsను appraise చేసి, State Coastal Zone Management Plansను prepare లేదా forward చేస్తుంది. June 2026లో Madhurawada–Bheemunipatnam stretchను CRZ-III B నుంచి CRZ-IIగా reclassify చేయాలని recommend చేసింది. 8 May 2026 NCZMA minutes ప్రకారం Andhra Pradesh CRZ-2019 plan ఇంకా pending; 13 coastal districtsలో 12 చోట్ల hearings complete కాగా Visakhapatnam మిగిలింది. ఇవి dated administrative stages మాత్రమే; permanent status statements కావు.

en: After bifurcation, Andhra Pradesh adopted its State symbols through G.O. 59 dated 30 May 2018: blackbuck as State animal, rose-ringed parakeet as State bird, neem as State tree and jasmine as State flower. Telangana's corresponding symbols are spotted deer, Indian roller, Jammi tree and Tangedu flower. The two sets must not be mixed because they belong to different States.
te: Bifurcation తర్వాత Andhra Pradesh 30 May 2018 నాటి G.O. 59 ద్వారా State symbolsను adopt చేసింది: blackbuck—State animal; rose-ringed parakeet—State bird; neem—State tree; jasmine—State flower. Telanganaలో corresponding symbols spotted deer, Indian roller, Jammi tree, Tangedu flower. ఇవి different Statesకు చెందిన sets కాబట్టి కలపకూడదు.

en: Andhra Pradesh examples connect general conservation principles with decisions on the ground. Tiger recovery in Nagarjunasagar–Srisailam can protect a large connected habitat but also increases the need to manage human–wildlife encounters. Narrow-range Eastern Ghats species illustrate extinction risk; red sanders shows CITES trade regulation; and the Chenchu example shows why conservation must respect community rights and participation. State institutions translate national law and policy into field action.
te: Andhra Pradesh examples general conservation principlesను ground-level decisionsతో connect చేస్తాయి. Nagarjunasagar–Srisailamలో tiger recovery large connected habitat protectionకు సహాయపడుతుంది; అదే సమయంలో human–wildlife encountersను manage చేయాల్సిన అవసరం పెరుగుతుంది. Narrow-range Eastern Ghats species extinction riskను చూపుతాయి; red sanders CITES trade regulationను వివరిస్తుంది; Chenchu example conservationలో community rights, participation ఎందుకు అవసరమో గుర్తుచేస్తుంది. National law, policyని field actionగా మార్చేది State institutions.

en: The BBNJ Agreement entered into force on 17 January 2026. It is the third implementing agreement under UNCLOS. Its four main issue areas are marine genetic resources including fair and equitable benefit-sharing; area-based management tools including marine protected areas; environmental impact assessments; and capacity-building and transfer of marine technology. It must be interpreted and applied consistently with UNCLOS and in a manner that does not undermine relevant legal instruments, frameworks and bodies.
te: BBNJ Agreement 17 January 2026న అమల్లోకి వచ్చింది. ఇది UNCLOS కింద మూడవ implementing agreement. దీని నాలుగు ప్రధాన అంశాలు: marine genetic resourcesతో పాటు fair and equitable benefit-sharing; marine protected areas సహా area-based management tools; environmental impact assessments; capacity-building, marine technology transfer. దీనిని UNCLOSకు అనుగుణంగా, సంబంధిత legal instruments, frameworks, bodiesను బలహీనపరచని విధంగా అమలు చేయాలి.

en: Amendments to the CMS Appendices adopted at CMS COP15 entered into force on 27 June 2026 under Article XI(5), subject to the Convention's reservation mechanism. COP15 had decided to add 40 taxa to the Appendices. Appendix I and Appendix II retain different legal functions: Appendix I concerns threatened migratory species requiring strict protection and habitat conservation, while Appendix II supports international cooperative instruments for species needing or benefiting from cooperation.
te: CMS COP15లో ఆమోదించిన Appendices amendments Article XI(5) ప్రకారం 27 June 2026న అమల్లోకి వచ్చాయి; Conventionలోని reservation mechanism దీనికి వర్తిస్తుంది. COP15 మొత్తం 40 taxaను Appendicesలో చేర్చాలని నిర్ణయించింది. Appendix I, Appendix II functions వేరు: Appendix I threatened migratory speciesకు strict protection, habitat conservationపై దృష్టి పెడుతుంది; Appendix II cooperation అవసరమైన లేదా cooperation వల్ల ప్రయోజనం పొందే species కోసం international cooperative instrumentsను ప్రోత్సహిస్తుంది.

en: Ramsar COP15 was held at Victoria Falls, Zimbabwe, from 23 to 31 July 2025. It adopted the Fifth Strategic Plan for 2025–2034. The Standing Committee elected at COP15 serves the 2025–2028 triennium, and Resolution XV.10 sets the scientific and technical work framework for 2025–2028. These are international governance facts and do not replace regulation under India's Wetlands Rules.
te: Ramsar COP15, 23–31 July 2025 మధ్య Victoria Falls, Zimbabweలో జరిగింది. అది Fifth Strategic Plan 2025–2034ను adopt చేసింది. Current Standing Committee term 2025–2028; Resolution XV.10 scientific, technical workకు 2025–2028 prioritiesను ఇచ్చింది. ఇవి international governance facts మాత్రమే; Ramsar designationను Indian Wetlands Rules regulationతో merge చేయవు.

en: A convention and a protocol are separate legal instruments. A State becomes bound through the applicable consent procedure; joining a parent convention does not automatically make it Party to every protocol under it.
te: Convention, protocol వేర్వేరు legal instruments. సంబంధిత consent procedure పూర్తయితేనే Stateకు బాధ్యతలు వర్తిస్తాయి; parent conventionలో చేరినంత మాత్రాన దాని ప్రతి protocolకు Party కాదు.

en: The CBD was adopted and opened for signature on 5 June 1992 and entered into force on 29 December 1993.
te: CBDను 5 June 1992న adopt చేసి signature కోసం open చేశారు; అది 29 December 1993న అమల్లోకి వచ్చింది.

en: Cartagena's Advance Informed Agreement procedure applies to specified LMOs intended for intentional introduction into the environment; it does not apply identically to every movement or use of an LMO.
te: Cartagenaలోని Advance Informed Agreement procedure, environmentలో intentional introduction కోసం ఉద్దేశించిన నిర్దిష్ట LMOsకు వర్తిస్తుంది; ప్రతి LMO movement లేదా useకు ఒకేలా వర్తించదు.

en: The Nagoya–Kuala Lumpur Supplementary Protocol entered into force on 5 March 2018. It concerns response measures for biodiversity damage from LMOs originating in transboundary movement, not general ABS.
te: Nagoya–Kuala Lumpur Supplementary Protocol 5 March 2018న అమల్లోకి వచ్చింది. ఇది transboundary movement నుంచి వచ్చిన LMOs వల్ల biodiversity damageకు response measures గురించి; general ABS గురించి కాదు.

en: CITES Appendix I does not prohibit every movement. Primarily commercial trade in wild-sourced specimens is generally prohibited, while exceptional non-commercial trade is controlled by import and export permits; qualifying captive-bred or artificially propagated commercial specimens may be treated under Appendix-II rules.
te: CITES Appendix I ప్రతి movementను నిషేధించదు. Wild-sourced specimens యొక్క primarily commercial trade సాధారణంగా నిషేధం; exceptional non-commercial tradeకు import, export permits అవసరం. అర్హత గల captive-bred లేదా artificially propagated commercial specimensకు Appendix-II rules వర్తించవచ్చు.

en: For CITES Appendix III, export from the Party that listed the species requires an export permit; export from another range State requires a certificate of origin, and re-export requires a re-export certificate.
te: CITES Appendix IIIలో speciesను list చేసిన Party నుంచి exportకు export permit అవసరం; మరో range State నుంచి exportకు certificate of origin, re-exportకు re-export certificate అవసరం.

en: CITES introduction from the sea means bringing into a State a specimen taken in a marine area beyond any State's jurisdiction. Its certificate and NDF rules apply to Appendices I and II, not Appendix III.
te: CITESలో introduction from the sea అంటే ఏ State jurisdictionకూ చెందని marine area నుంచి తీసిన specimenను ఒక Stateలోకి తేవడం. దీనికి సంబంధించిన certificate, NDF rules Appendices I, IIకు వర్తిస్తాయి; Appendix IIIకు కాదు.

en: The IUCN Red List assesses extinction risk, CITES Appendices regulate international trade, and India's Wild Life (Protection) Act Schedules determine domestic legal protection. A change in one system does not automatically change the others.
te: IUCN Red List extinction riskను assess చేస్తుంది; CITES Appendices international tradeను regulate చేస్తాయి; India's Wild Life (Protection) Act Schedules domestic legal protectionను నిర్ణయిస్తాయి. ఒక systemలో change వచ్చినంత మాత్రాన మిగతావి automaticగా మారవు.

en: A biosphere reserve has three connected functions: conservation, sustainable development, and logistic support through research, monitoring, education and training. Core, buffer and transition zones support these functions in different ways.
te: Biosphere reserveకు మూడు connected functions ఉన్నాయి: conservation, sustainable development, research-monitoring-education-training ద్వారా logistic support. Core, buffer, transition zones ఈ functionsను వేర్వేరు విధాలుగా support చేస్తాయి.

en: The Plant Treaty Multilateral System covers 64 Annex-I food crops and forages and uses the Standard Material Transfer Agreement. Farmers' Rights include traditional knowledge, benefit-sharing and participation in decisions, with implementation resting on national governments under national law.
te: Plant Treaty Multilateral System Annex Iలోని 64 food crops, foragesను cover చేసి Standard Material Transfer Agreementను ఉపయోగిస్తుంది. Farmers' Rightsలో traditional knowledge, benefit-sharing, decisionsలో participation ఉంటాయి; national law ప్రకారం implementation national governments బాధ్యత.

en: India released its updated NBSAP for 2024–2030 at CBD COP16 in October 2024. It aligns with the KMGBF's four goals and 23 targets and sets 23 National Biodiversity Targets; aligned global and national targets are not identical legal provisions.
te: India తన updated NBSAP 2024–2030ను October 2024లో CBD COP16 వద్ద విడుదల చేసింది. ఇది KMGBFలోని four goals, 23 targetsతో align అయి 23 National Biodiversity Targetsను నిర్దేశిస్తుంది; aligned global, national targets ఒకే legal provisions కావు.

en: India submitted its Seventh CBD National Report on 26 February 2026 under CBD Article 26, using 142 national indicators mapped to 23 National Biodiversity Targets. It submitted its first Nagoya Protocol implementation report on 27 February 2026 under Protocol Article 29; the reports have different legal bases and subjects.
te: India 23 National Biodiversity Targetsకు map చేసిన 142 national indicatorsతో Seventh CBD National Reportను CBD Article 26 కింద 26 February 2026న submit చేసింది. First Nagoya Protocol implementation reportను Protocol Article 29 కింద 27 February 2026న submit చేసింది; రెండింటి legal bases, subjects వేరు.

en: The fifth Global Biodiversity Outlook found that none of the 20 Aichi Targets was fully achieved globally by 2020, although six were partially achieved.
te: Fifth Global Biodiversity Outlook ప్రకారం 2020 నాటికి 20 Aichi Targetsలో ఒక్కటీ globalగా fully achieve కాలేదు; అయితే ఆరు partially achieve అయ్యాయి.

en: KMGBF Target 19 seeks at least US$200 billion per year from all sources by 2030. Within it, international biodiversity finance to developing countries should reach at least US$20 billion yearly by 2025 and US$30 billion yearly by 2030.
te: KMGBF Target 19 ప్రకారం 2030 నాటికి అన్ని sources నుంచి సంవత్సరానికి కనీసం US$200 billion mobilize చేయాలి. ఇందులో developing countriesకు international biodiversity finance 2025 నాటికి US$20 billion, 2030 నాటికి US$30 billion yearly చేరాలి.

en: Under Nagoya, PIC is required where the provider country's domestic ABS law requires it; MAT arrange benefit-sharing. The Protocol also addresses traditional knowledge associated with genetic resources and relevant community rights under domestic law.
te: Nagoya కింద provider country domestic ABS law కోరినప్పుడు PIC అవసరం; MAT benefit-sharingను arrange చేస్తాయి. Genetic resourcesకు సంబంధించిన traditional knowledge, domestic law కింద community rightsను కూడా Protocol address చేస్తుంది.

en: Ramsar's wise-use obligation applies to all wetlands in a Party's territory, not only Ramsar Sites. The Convention was adopted on 2 February 1971, the date observed as World Wetlands Day, and entered into force on 21 December 1975.
te: Ramsar wise-use obligation Party territoryలోని అన్ని wetlandsకు వర్తిస్తుంది; Ramsar Sitesకే కాదు. Convention 2 February 1971న adopt అయింది—ఆ తేదీ World Wetlands Day—మరియు 21 December 1975న forceలోకి వచ్చింది.

en: World Heritage inscription requires Outstanding Universal Value, at least one of ten criteria, and adequate protection and management. The Committee will not consider a nomination unless the property is already on the State Party's Tentative List.
te: World Heritage inscriptionకు Outstanding Universal Value, ten criteriaలో కనీసం ఒకటి, adequate protection-management అవసరం. Property State Party Tentative Listలో లేకపోతే Committee nominationను consider చేయదు.

en: India signed the BBNJ Agreement on 25 September 2024. In the UN Treaty Collection record checked for the lesson draft, India had not deposited ratification; this dynamic status must be rechecked because signature, ratification and becoming a Party are distinct stages.
te: India BBNJ Agreementపై 25 September 2024న sign చేసింది. Lesson draft కోసం check చేసిన UN Treaty Collection recordలో ratification deposit చేయలేదు; signature, ratification, Party కావడం వేర్వేరు stages కాబట్టి ఈ dynamic statusను recheck చేయాలి.

en: BBNJ Article 52 provides a financial mechanism comprising a voluntary trust fund, a special fund and the GEF Trust Fund. These related components are not one interchangeable fund.
te: BBNJ Article 52 financial mechanismలో voluntary trust fund, special fund, GEF Trust Fund ఉంటాయి. ఇవి related components; ఒకే interchangeable fund కావు.
